(ja)༄༅/ /srung ba'i lha mo lnga la brten nas byad 'grol ba'i cho ga dag gsal mdor bsdus te bkod pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru be/gzungs chen ga

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// srung ba'i lha mo lnga la brten nas byad 'grol ba'i cho ga dag gsal mdor bsdus te bkod pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru be/ gzungs chen grwa lnga las gsungs pa'i rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga'i byed 'grol byed pa la sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom ni/ bdag mdun bum pa'i gshom rnams gzhung ltar rnam bum dang las bum gnyis bcud ldan chas su bcug pa bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar ram phyogs ji ltar bde bar zhi ba'i me thab spyi mthun grub na legs/ bsdu na zangs lcags la sogs pa'i snod du rdul tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ de steng me tog dkar pos lha lnga'i tshom bu dgod/ mtha' nas bud shing zlum por brtsigs/ mchod yon nyer spyod/ 'bul gtor dkar zlum rnams ji ltar bde bar bsham/ dkyil 'khor mdun du me tog dkar po'i snod bzhag bsreg rdzas mar khu/ seng ldeng ngam rgya shug gi yam shing*/ 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang glud gzugs gcig changs bu nyer gcig yos dang 'bru dkar bsres pa/ sbyong ba'i chas/ byab rdzas bdun/ stan dkar gsar pa/ tshon skud sna lnga ring po bsrung bya'i grangs mnyam/ gri rnon po rnams tshogs par bya'o// dngos gzhi'i thog mar bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ldang*/ bum pa bsgrubs la bzlas pa nan tan bya/ mdun bskyed gtor 'bul bcas grub nas byad 'grol dngos la/ zhu ba po rnams spos kyis bdug gral du 'khod pa la me tog dkar po gtor/ a mṛ ta brjod la bsang*/ de la thog mar mdun gyi dkyil 'khor 'di ltar gsal 'debs par zhu/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su ri rab kyi rtser sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga bzhugs pa ni/ dbus su so sor 'brang ma sku mdog ser mo sogs mngon rtogs ltar la/

rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa'o// bar brjod/ tshogs zhing dkyil 'khor gyi lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pas bsags sbyong spel gsum bya ba'i 'dun pa rtse gcig pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i sogs tshar gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug de nas zhi sbyong*/ zhi drag phyed ma/ drag pos sbyong ba/ bgegs bskrad/ til sbyong bcas spyi ltar bya/ ma ṇi dha rī'i sngags brjod la me tog dkar po 'thor/ gdan ji ltar 'os par bzhag la/ tshon skud sna lnga grol mdud kyi a long lnga byas la dbus kyi che ba de ske la bskon/ g.yas kyi gnyis lag pa dang rkang pa g.yas kyi srin mdzub la bskon/ g.yon gnyis kyis kyang de ltar bya/ skye bo mang po la de ltar ma 'grub na tshon skud gcig gis thams cad kyi srin mdzub la sbrel yang rung ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis/ rang nyid so sor 'brang ma sku mdog ser mo sogs nas/ lha'i rgyan dang gos thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bsgrub bya 'di nyid la gnod par byed pa/ phyi rol 'jig rten gyi khams dang nang lus la gnas pa thams cad zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus drangs shing*/ gzhan yang sdig sgrib nad gdon bag chags skal ba ngan pa thams cad bkug ste byad thag 'di la thim/ khyad par du yang sa las byung ba bad kan gyi nad rnams tshon skud ser po la thim/ chu las gyur pa grang ba'i nad rnams dkar po la thim/ me las gyur pa khrag mkhris rnams dmar po la thim/ rlung las gyur pa rlung gi nad rnams sngon po la thim/ 'byung ba sna tshogs 'dus pa las gyur pa dang*/ ldan pa dang*/ 'dus pa'i nad rnams ljang gu la thim par gyur/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/

bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ lha rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ drang srong rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di dag la 'tshe bar byed pa'i sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bgegs dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ byad ma byur chag skal ba ngan pa/ dus kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya/ bgegs dang log 'dren/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshon skud sna lnga pa/ 'di la thim par gyur cig ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum 'dod pa'i rgyal po phyag rgya dang bcas te bya/ de nas gri gu me dang chur rim gyis bcug ste/ ma ṇi dha rī'i sngags bzla zhing 'di skad ces/ las kyi slob dpon so sor 'brang ma'i skur gyur pa'i phyag g.yas su ral gri thogs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i ngo bo byad thag de dum bur gtubs par mos pa mdzod/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*// tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong*// gnod sbyin ded dpon dbang phyug dang*// de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*// de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyis// deng 'dir bsgrub bya 'di dag gi /byad stems las rnams chad gyur cig /sarba ban+dha kā khor dha ts+tshe da nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing tshon skud rnams yan lag lnga la bskon pa'i sa nas/ mtshon kha phar gtad de bcad/ de bsgrub bya'i lus la bskor nas/

rdo rje slob ma'am bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā/ zhes lan bdun du brjod de snod gcig tu bsag de nas thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab khung dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhi ba'i thab khung gi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su pram̐ ser po nas/ lha mo lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus su so sor 'brang ma sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren skabs dkyil 'khor gyi drung nas me tog phor pa blangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs dang*/ me tog tshom gcig me la dor/ de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang*/ byin rlabs spyi ltar bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa rak+ṣa de ba tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da zhes pa rnams bcug la mchod/ so sor 'brang dang stong chen rab 'byams dang*// rma bya chen mo gsang sngags rjes su 'brang*// bsil ba'i tshal te ye shes lnga yi sku// gzungs sngags rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces brjod/ bcom ldan 'das ma lnga'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me 'bar/ bsgrub bya 'di rnams kyi nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs par gyur/ rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang*// me yis bud shing bsreg pa dang*// rlung gis sprin rnams gtor ba dang*// nyi mas nags tshal skems byed dang*// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis// byad stems las rnams tshig par shog /sarba ban+dha kā khor dha dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ dang por lha mo lnga'i snying po'i mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes btags pas mar khu phul/

'di dgang blugs kyis phul na legs mod/ ma 'byor na snod ci bde bas phul/ sngags lnga po de nyid kyis yam shing yang phul/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'bru sna tshogs nas 'bru tshom re 'bul ba dang*/ mchod g.yog pas sngar gyi tshon skud kyi ro de dum bu mang por gtubs/ tsho nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bcos nas/ tshon skud tsho re dang*/ changs bu re lag pa g.yas g.yon so sor bzung nas/ bsgrub bya la bskor ba'i tshul byas nas me la 'bul zhing*/ sngags lnga po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa'am/ bsdu na dang por sngags lnga po tshar gcig gi mthar/ bsgrub bya che ge mo'i nad gdon sdig sgrib byad ka rbod gtong mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshig par gyur cig shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes btags pa tshar gcig dang*/ de rjes ma ṇi dha rī kho na la las sngags de nyid btags pa nyi shu 'bul/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// zhes pa nas/ kā khor+dha dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ bsgrub bya che ge mo'i nad dang nas/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes me dang bsgrub bya la bum chu gtor/ me'i dbal zhi bar gyur/ gong bzhin mar dang yam shing phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig dang*/ de rjes spro na 'dod gsol rgyas pa bya/ bsdu na skabs 'dir 'dod gsol med kyang chog yig brgya bzod gsol spyi dang 'dra/ ye shes pa mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar thim zhes/ me tog gi snod me la bskor nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bzhag dkyil 'khor la me tog gtor/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas khrus bya ba'i thog mar dkyil 'khor pa la lha khrus/ sku phyi/ gos 'bul ba'i bar spyi ltar bya/ khrus chu de las bum du blugs pa slob dpon gyis thogs te thog mar ku shas bum chu blangs te bsgrub bya'i spyi bo nas gtor/ de rjes khrus byar gzhug cing*/ sngags lnga po tshar gcig gi mthar/

sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad thams cad/ gdon thams cad/ rims thams cad/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad/ 'khon thams cad/ grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad/ byad ka thams cad/ byur thams cad/ skal ba ngan pa thams cad/ gzhan gyis mthu gtad sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa thams cad/ rbod gtong thams cad/ ro langs kyi las thams cad/ gdon gyi las thams cad/ mnan pa dang 'ching ba'i las thams cad/ bsregs pa dang phur bus btab pa thams cad/ sems g.yeng ba dang sgyur bar byed pa thams cad/ sngags dang rdzas ngan pa byas pa thams cad/ 'khrul 'khor dang mkhyud dpyad ngan pa thams cad/ bza' nyes dang 'gom nyes la sogs pa thams cad/ gzhan gyis las ngan pa byas pa thams cad/ rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad/ ltas ngan pa thams cad/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad/ lo keg zla keg zhag keg dus keg thams cad/ chag che nyam nga thams cad/ sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i gnod pa thams cad/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad/ mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon thams cad/ dus kyi zhags pa thams cad/ gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cad/ rgyal po dang the'u rang gi gnod pa thams cad/ btsan dang mu'i gnod pa thams cad/ bdud dang mdangs 'phrog gi gnod pa thams cad/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa la sogs pa mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas dug zhi bar byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzi brjid dang*// rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*// dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang*// gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*// shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*// mau gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*// ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni// 'od srung sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// kauṇ+ḍi n+ya yi sngar thob dang*// kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*// tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang*// brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*// dbang phyug chen po'i stobs rnams dang*// sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*// 'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*// de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis// bsgrub bya'i dug ni dug med shog

/dug med dug rnams 'jig byed shog /s+yād+ya thed na/ ha ri ke shi na ki li/ e he re/ a ma re/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ ke ṭa ke ke yū re/ ha se ha se ha se/ kha se kha se kha se/ kha raṃ ge ma ru ga ha ṇe swā hā/ mu muk+ṣa swā hā/ hi le swā hā/ mi le swā hā/ 'bras dang rma dang shu ba dang*// g.yan pa dang ni 'brum bu dang*// lhog pa dag dang g.ya' ba ni// bdun pa lags te rab tu bcom// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum yin// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// de bzhin/ bcom ldan dam chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun= ces 'don pa spo'o// sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di yis su// dug gsum sa yi nang du song*// de bzhin chu me rlung rnams la'ang 'don pa spo'o// de nas byabs pa ni/ byabs pa'i rdzas bdun du grags pa/ ku sha/ rma bya'i mdongs/ bya rog gi dong ru/ yungs kar gong bu/ me long*/ ral gri/ dar tshon sna lnga rnams lag tu thogs/ sngar gyi khrus sder dri khu dang bcas pa'i nang du glud gzugs gcig bcug bsgrub bya'i kha ru bum chu cung zad 'dzin du bcug la/ sngags thung lnga po'i mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā/ zhes sogs gong dang 'dra ba las shān+tiṃ ku ru zhes pa'i sar a pa nā ya zhes 'don pa spos la/ byabs pa'i tha mar bsgrub bya nyid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs phra zhing phra ba rus la zhen pa thams cad nag bun gyis skyugs nas klud gzugs la thim par mos shig byas la/ kha nang bum chu glud gzugs la pho/ slob dpon skad cig gis khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa zhes pa nas/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rdo rje slob ma'am bsgrub bya 'di dag la gnod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs log 'dren mi mthun par byed pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces yungs kar gyis brab/

gu gul gyis bdug drag sngags dang rol chen gyis mtshams gcad do// khrus khu dang glud gzugs chu bo'am bzhi mdor bskyal/ de nas rgyal ba brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal// chos ni chos ma yin las so// dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal// dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal// lha min zla ba las rgyal lo// nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las// me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal// chu ni me las rgyal bar gyur// rlung ni sprin las rnam par rgyal// rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas// sa yang bden par gnas pa lags// sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden// bden pas rgyal gyur rdzun ma mgal// sdig pa thams cad rab tu pham// phyi rgol kun las rgyal bar gyur/ swā hā/ bsgrub bya rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ oṃ dza ye bi dza ye swā hā/ dza ya dza ya zhes brjod cing gdan dkar po gsar pa me tog dkar po gsar pas gtor ba la bzhag de nas srung ba ni/ slob dpon gyis bsgrub bya'i gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram bzhag pas/ rdo rje'i go bskon par mos te/ sngags thung lnga po'i mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes sogs gong bkru byab kyi sngags rnams la rak+ṣa zhes 'don pa spo'o// rgyas par skabs 'dir rig gtad mdzad kyang bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir mi dgos/ mthar kha zas kyis bsrung ba ni/ 'brang rgyas dkar po sbyin pa'am 'o ma la sman sna btab pa khar sbyin te/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*// gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*// thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*// log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*// gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*// 'od srung kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*// shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur// bad kan gyur dang 'dus las gyur// nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste// khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog

/de la ni kha zas kyis srung ba zhes zer te dga' ston gyi tshul lo// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang med pa'am/ rkang pa gnyis pa'am/ rkang pa bzhi pa'am/ rkang mangs sam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag las de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ba dang*/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang nas 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ba dang*/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs pa'am/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig de rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar bya'o// mtshams gcad par bya'o// 'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o// gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o// nad rigs bzhi rgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig ces pa ni bden stobs brjod pas bsrung ba'o// de nas rang ngam bsgrub bya la me tog 'thor te/ ston mchog dam pa sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni rgyal ba sogs brjod de bkra shis brjod pas bsrung*/ bsngo smon byas la grol/ slob dpon gyis mdun bum gyi lha la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ nongs bshags yig brgya bzla/ rten yod na ye shes pa brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di'ang rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i dgongs pa skong ba'i slad du rmongs rtul 'du gsum pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos shin tu khungs btsun pa'i gong ma'i legs bshad la brten nas dag gsal snying por bril te tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dben gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
